title: Sindhu, Ayush, Unnati Advance; Lakshya Sen Exits Asian Games
indian_angle: Indian badminton stars PV Sindhu, Ayush Shetty, and Unnati Hooda progressed to the next round at the Asian Games, while former All England finalist Lakshya Sen was eliminated.
summary: World No. 11 PV Sindhu defeated Chiu Pin-chian of Chinese Taipei 21-19, 21-14 in the women's singles second round. Ayush Shetty and Unnati Hooda also advanced, but Lakshya Sen's campaign ended with a second-round loss.

title: India Secures Double Gold in Kabaddi at Asian Games
indian_angle: While badminton is the focus, the entire Indian contingent's performance at the Asian Games is a source of national pride, with both men's and women's kabaddi teams securing gold.
summary: India achieved a remarkable kabaddi golden double at the Asian Games 2026, with both the men's and women's teams triumphing in their respective finals, adding significant gold medals to the nation's tally.

title: Asian Games Day 9: Indian Badminton Stars Set for Action
indian_angle: Indian badminton enthusiasts can look forward to the Day 9 schedule of the Asian Games, which will feature key matches involving Indian athletes.
summary: The full schedule for Day 9 of the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, has been released, detailing the IST timings and events where Indian athletes, including those in badminton, will be competing.

title: Satwik-Chirag Suffer Shock First Round Exit at Asian Games
indian_angle: India's highly-ranked men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, were unexpectedly knocked out in the first round of the Asian Games.
summary: The world No.5 Indian pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty were defeated by Thailand's Pakkapon Teeraratsakul and Peeratchai Sukphun in a surprising first-round upset at the Asian Games.
